patch.value: Live acceptance: two tev1:4b generations through npm run test:live

Add npm run test:live (excluded from CI and from the coverage gate) that runs two real training generations of the System One decision-model loop against the locally served frozen model, showing changed checkpoints and the promoted successor collecting, and paste the measured numbers (accuracy and ECE before vs after, endpoint latency, token usage) into a pm comment on the adapter feature.

npm run test:live executes two real generations against the configured endpoint and model, asserts the candidate checkpoint changes each generation and that generation two collects with generation one's promoted checkpoint, and prints measured before/after accuracy, ECE, latency and token totals; npm test and the coverage gate never invoke the live suite; the measured numbers are recorded as a pm comment on the adapter feature item

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Live acceptance first run PASS: two real tev1:4b generations promoted; generation 2 collection component equals generation 1 candidate checkpoint. Held-out accuracy 1.0 -> 1.0 in both generations; ECE 0.3329814443 -> 0.2927389850 -> 0.2411651910. Sampled held-out means 0.66375 -> 0.70685 and 0.709475 -> 0.761025. Changed checkpoints 77bb31851756 then a66accd456bf. Eight endpoint requests, 1094 reported tokens, wall elapsed 23189.12 ms (2898.64 ms per query including tracker/training overhead). Endpoint-only latency instrumentation is being added and will be rerun. This two-item synthetic held-out split measures adaptive validation, not an independent benchmark.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final live receipt: npm run test:live passed twice against tev1:4b; both generations promoted and successor collection used the first promoted checkpoint. Accuracy 1.0 to 1.0 in both generations; ECE 0.33298144430342114 to 0.292738985014186 to 0.24116519096373423. Held-out sampled means 0.66375 to 0.70685 and 0.709475 to 0.761025. Tokens 547 per generation, 1094 total across eight queries. Repeat wall time 26157.710259 ms; endpoint time 23302.171132 ms, 2912.7713915 ms per query. Distinct digests and original numbers are in prior comments. Final release gate passed 387 tests and four 100% coverage metrics across 23 source files; PM-linked deterministic acceptance passed. Added packaged System One configuration and measured validation document.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Live acceptance evidence and packaged System One example are published in draft PR https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/pull/62. Repeat final tarball acceptance passes in npm/Node and Bun. The 23 authored source files are unchanged from the full 387-test four-metric release gate. Claim released; feature remains open for verification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implement a fresh two-generation live receipt with retained per-query PM evidence, explicit promotion decisions and checkpoint lineage. Keep unit/integration tests on synthetic HTTP servers, live execution opt-in and bounded to 15 minutes. Check adversarial contamination, checkpoint and endpoint failure paths; run npm and Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: remove only the new num_gpu CPU preflight condition while retaining signatures and tests. npm run build succeeds; node --test --test-name-pattern="CPU validation" test/live-systemone.test.ts fails with Missing expected rejection. Restore the guard for final gates. Live cold-load attempts have failed closed before training; retain their partial trackers and retry only within the bounded local CPU execution window.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Move the watchdog into a minimal launcher so its hard process deadline also includes SDK imports and startup. The worker has the shared AbortSignal; the parent terminates it at 895000 ms and escalates within the remaining five seconds. Permit a declared CPU allocation of one to four threads with num_gpu 0 and per-response zero-VRAM checks. Earlier cold-load and two-thread scoring attempts failed before any promotion; final live and exact-source gates remain pending.

value.text: CodeRabbit round 4 (scripts/live-systemone.ts:147): the worker deadline (900 s) was later than the watchdog kill (LIVE_TIMEOUT_MS minus 5 s grace = 895 s), so a deadline stop could never retain failure.json. Added LIVE_WORKER_DEADLINE_MS = LIVE_TIMEOUT_MS - 30 s in live-watchdog.ts and main() passes it; test 'the live worker deadline expires before the watchdog kills the worker' asserts the ordering with at least 10 s headroom.
